[quote=the_crystalline_empire;58913343][b]March 25, 2025[/b]
The blockade had begun, 45 ships from the 1st blockade group had arrived silently at dawn, moving into position in a wide circle around Sikirsk. As the sun rose over the island state, more bombers of a more visible and non-silent type would begin bombing raids on critical infrastructure, including: Factories, Ammunitions Depots, Train-Stations, Airports, and critical linkage points. 
In the meantime the Thýven Department of Defense would announce the release of 45,000 soldiers from inactive duty to active duty, to begin deployment in Sikirsk. A combination of air-lifts and naval transport would be used, and the troops would be estimated to arrive at the blockade by March 30th. 
Once again another message would be sent out to the comms of Sikirsk offering an olive branch of peace, stating, Due to the nature of Sal-Baliz and threats in the region, it is necessary for Thýven to enact a policy of deterrence in the region.
